summary: Candidate 'Axis Generator Configuration' is a distinct D3 visualization capability focused on axis generation (reference marks for scales). It differs semantically from peer candidates (shape rendering, line generation, radial line generation) and existing skills (Flink streaming). No existing skill covers axis configuration, tick customization, or scale-to-axis binding. The support evidence confirms d3-axis API coverage. This warrants creation as a new session_skill.
